reason: Useful architecture in general, but no independent evaluation remains and the bottleneck is target/prior confounding rather than receptive field.
Variate-token modelling is poorly matched to the current per-asset pooled window design and would require a new synchronized panel estimand.
Exogenous-token modelling cannot repair current-vintage macro provenance and would intensify the macro confound.
Order destruction left pooled ranking effectively unchanged; adding scales would be architecture shopping.
Every input token precedes the forecast origin and the encoder is non-autoregressive; a causal mask would answer a different question.
